scope: Internal executed software tests. Not an independent geolocation benchmark, user study, accepted contest entry or payment.

parity.method: Separate brute-force 64-address oracle, Python streaming engine, JS BigInt engine. Synthetic cases except unchanged official vendor samples.

scale.scope: One paired synthetic CSV run, not representative accuracy, production capacity or real vendor drift. Memory includes Python runtime; input generation excluded from timing.

checks: Export is unavailable before a current computation
Real Web Worker detects the synthetic decision changes and removed vendor-sample range
Lost database coverage is displayed as review, never allow
Downloaded review has source hashes and aggregate replay without raw traffic IPs
Browser source fingerprint matches the actual bundled vendor sample bytes
Input edits clear the old report and invalidate exports
Unmodified official vendor sample self-comparison has no changes
Policy-only edits are included, even with identical database bytes
The last IPv6 address changes exactly once without floating-point rounding
Invalid overlapping data produces a visible error and no export
Untrusted country-name markup is not inserted into the document
Native file input feeds the actual comparison worker
Cancel terminates computation and ignores delayed results
390-pixel layout fits without page-level horizontal overflow
No page errors, external requests or input-upload requests during the tested workflows
